checks.name: Security self-review
checks.note: No console logging of passwords/tokens/secrets anywhere in lib/ or app/. Admin credential failures return generic 'Invalid email or password' without revealing which check failed (unknown account vs wrong password), though audit log internally distinguishes for operator visibility. Passwords hashed with bcrypt (cost 12 in seed, default in compare). Role stored server-side in JWT/session, never trusted from client. middleware.ts's matcher is now ['/admin/:path*'] only (no /dashboard route exists to protect); lib/authorize.ts provides matching server-side requireSession/requireAdmin guards for API routes (defense in depth beyond middleware). .env.local (dummy dev values) and all .env* files gitignored. No raw PATs/GitHub tokens handled in this module (GithubToken model is global/ownerless per M03, populated via the public submit-token flow, not touched here).

backend.summary: CURRENT STATE (corrected 2026-08-17): apps/web (Next.js 14 App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind). Prisma User model represents ONLY admin accounts (passwordHash, bcrypt-hashed, set only via prisma/seed.ts from SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL/SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD — no self-serve signup) plus AuditLog for signin/signout/admin-signin-failure events. There is no Account/Session/VerificationToken model (Auth.js Prisma adapter tables) — they were dropped by migration 20260817050000_remove_user_oauth_and_token_ownership, since Credentials-only NextAuth v4 with JWT sessions does not use PrismaAdapter. Auth.js (NextAuth v4) is configured with exactly one provider: a Credentials provider ('admin-credentials') gated to role=ADMIN accounts with a set passwordHash — no GitHub OAuth provider exists. middleware.ts's matcher is ['/admin/:path*'] only; any /admin/* request requires an authenticated session, and role!==ADMIN redirects to /unauthorized.
